name: Logging Rope
summary: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, Logging Rope keeps the mills and machinery supplied. Furbolg tribes have stolen shipments across Ashenvale, leaving the Warsong to recover the line they need.

sections.title: Stolen Lines
sections.body: Logging Rope shipments meant for the Warsong Lumber Camp have been stolen. The Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs intercepted the line before it reached the loggers. The tribes keep the ropes in their encampments across northern and central Ashenvale. Corruption has driven the furbolgs mad, and they fiercely defend their ancestral woods.

sections.title: Supplying the War Effort
sections.body: Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post seeks to recover the stolen supplies before work at the Warsong Lumber Camp stops. The heavy rope lets the Horde secure timber, bind logs, and rig saw machinery. Furbolg resistance continues across the forest.

faq.q: What is Logging Rope used for?
faq.answer: The Warsong Lumber Camp uses Logging Rope to secure harvested timber, haul logs, and rig heavy machinery in Ashenvale.
The Foulweald and Thistlefur furbolgs stole the logging rope and keep it in their village dens and encampments across Ashenvale.
Locke Okarr at Splintertree Post wants the rope returned with the other stolen supplies so work at the Warsong Lumber Camp can continue.

faq.q: Why do the furbolgs steal logging supplies?
faq.answer: The furbolgs steal logging supplies to disrupt the Horde's lumber mills and resist its logging in their ancestral woods.

angles.text: Recovering Logging Rope helps keep the Warsong clan supplied with timber despite the furbolg ambushes.
As an orc, you depend on Ashenvale lumber for settlement in Kalimdor. Stolen logging supplies threaten that work.
